headlines.title: Blanche won’t rule out DOJ post-election action in a ‘doomsday’ scenario
headlines.description: Attorney General Todd Blanche on Thursday left open the possibility for the Justice Department to seek to block states from certifying votes.

headlines.title: Inside Iowa’s critical midterm Senate race
headlines.description: NBC Nightly News anchor Tom Llamas interviews Democrat Josh Turek, Republican Ashley Hinson and voters in Iowa.

headlines.title: Trump ordered to sit for deposition in BBC lawsuit
headlines.description: A federal judge in Florida ordered President Donald Trump to sit for a deposition in his defamation lawsuit against the BBC by Dec. 11, or face the possibility of having his $10 billion action dismissed.

headlines.title: On Main Street, Goldman Sachs makes a big bet on AI
headlines.description: Goldman Sachs partners with OpenAI, Google, Meta and Anthropic to boost AI adoption among small businesses.

headlines.title: Airbnb hosts can no longer ask guests to clean dishes or make beds
headlines.description: Airbnb hosts can only set “reasonable” housecleaning duties for guests, according to new guidelines rolled out by the tech giant, with tasks such as dishwashing and bed stripping now the sole responsibility of homeowners.

headlines.title: Ohio gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton condemns ad featuring her estranged mother
headlines.description: Ohio Democratic gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton is condemning a new ad circulating online featuring her estranged mother. NBC News national politics reporter Henry Gomez discusses how close the race between Acton and Republican candidate Vivek Ramaswamy has become in the campaign's final two weeks.

headlines.description: Ohio Gov. Mike DeWine is calling for Vivek Ramaswamy to stop airing an ad that features the estranged mother of Ramaswamy’s Democratic opponent, Amy Acton.

headlines.title: Judi Dench says she can no longer act or read due to worsening eye condition
headlines.description: Judi Dench said an eye condition has left her unable to read or perform on stage, more than a decade after she was first diagnosed.

headlines.title: Market sell-off gains steam as concerns about Iran war and high AI spending collide
headlines.description: U.S. equity markets sold off sharply as fears that Israel and the U.S. would attack Iran sent oil prices higher, while stocks failed to hold onto recent gains.
